title: 고등법원 부의 지방법원 소재지에서의 사무처리에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:12:0:00012:part:1/1
title_original: 고등법원 부의 지방법원 소재지에서의 사무처리에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 12 (Forwarding to Prosecutors' Office)
(1) Where a prosecutor of the prosecutors' office corresponding to a High Court works at the location of an outlying division of the High Court, the chief court clerk, court clerk, junior administrative officer, senior court clerk, or court clerk (hereinafter referred to as "court clerk, etc.") in charge may forward to that prosecutor the completed records and written judgments of criminal or protective-custody cases tried by the outlying division. <Amended on May 20, 1995; February 20, 2008>
(2) Paragraph (1) shall also apply when the court clerk, etc. in charge gives notice of the result of a criminal judgment or protective-custody judgment.
